is why the Green Path is the canon path... Maybe the green choice can be a miserable one in the short term, but in the long term, you never get to witness growth such as this.
The amusement park event started out really wholesome. I'm just bummed Akira wasn't there. I've always wanted to see him take Io to the amusement park like she always wanted. Imagine it! Akira, Io and Uta at the amusement park together, getting up to a bunch of shenanigans and maybe bumping into the Takoyaki Guy again. XD That would've been a fun event. Even still, though, it was great to see two best friends hanging out together.
I still won't lose hope in the eventual Dorm 7 throuple! It's too enticing of an idea to not explore one day.
As for the latter half of the event... oooooh man. I don't think my protective instincts have flared up so much in quite awhile. Those two NPCs were creepy asf... I'm glad Yuki showed up and dealt with them.
Still... Yuki's not looking too good these days, huh? I worry for her physical health and how it will impact not only her, but also Yumi and Kaori when they discover something's wrong.
Yumi discovering her mom relapsed is deeefinitely a drama that's bound to show up later, and it won't be pretty when it does.

spoilers.title: Osako
spoilers.html:
I used to not like Osako, and I don't think many others did either. But I gotta say... much like Otoha, Osako is really growing on me lately. I dig her friendship with Akira a lot and honestly am really invested in where her journey of self-discovery will take her.

Seeing Noriko and Kirin at the Witchcraft class was a welcome surprise. Of course Kirin would try to create a love potion. I've said it before and I'll say it again: Noriko is an angel and must be protected at all costs.

I also mentioned earlier how Akira needs to find a new hobby or... needs to make a change in his life so that he'll best be able to focus on things besides constant unhealthy sex, and really, like Noriko mentioned, I believe his friendship with Osako is the perfect way to get started on that. They're both lost and confused right now, and this is the perfect way to see them both bond.

I'm on the fence about Akira quitting teaching at school. On the one hand, I'd miss that aspect of his character, but on the other hand, seeing him do something new opens a lot of different possibilities. Wakana definitely wouldn't take that well, but we'll see where it leads.

Also, I guess Osako knows that Akira is a predator now... No more speculation on whether or not she's aware, because the confession at the bar sealed the deal. I don't have any deep insight on this particular detail, but all I know is it'll be interesting to see how Osako reacts to certain things from now on. Things that Imani and (presumably) Wakana don't even know.

Rika is undoubtedly suspicious after the Rin stuff, though. As she should be. She also has events in 0.48, so I believe we'll get to see how she responds veeery soon.

But yeah. Osako is growing on me lately. I genuinely look forward to how her story progresses.

spoilers.title: Chika
spoilers.html:
What can I say? It's just sad all around to witness the state she's in these days... She wants so much for her new family to not fall apart that she deludes herself. I can't blame her for it, either. It really is all Akira's fault.

They both talked to each other after leaving the Maid Cafe, but it didn't really go anywhere. I mean, like one of the narrators said afterwards: one talk just isn't enough to fix everything.

I really hope Rin can act as an anchor for her in this difficult time, if only a little bit. But hey, if nothing else, Chika's TSS experience is sure to have changed her a bit, right?

...That was such a weird ending tbh. With blonde Chika returning home and Chinami looking like... whatever the hell that mannequin looking thing was. Very jarring.

posts.content_html_raw:
I don't regret saying skipping Stomachache even after viewing both sides, although there's certainly pros and cons for either one.

There may be a chance it comes back to bite me in the future, but choosing not to fuck her makes her feel so relieved and reassured and I personally feel it's 100% worth it (for the short term at the very least.)
(Stomachache skip route)



For one of the first times in her life, she starting to feel "safe." Something she has been wanting for so long.






She REALLY wants him to tell her she's safe T_T she wants to hear those words, feel them.





In both routes they end up holding hands while playing the game until she leaves, but only in red path does he verbally acknowledge and ask her for it. That makes the red path actually feel more canon to me for once.

Now to why I put emphasis on the short term; this could very well backfire if Akira can't keep his blackouts in check.
If the worst happened and he forced himself on her while in a delusion after giving finally her hope, it could absolutely destroy her.

That is the one big merit to going through with Stomachache and probably how it could possibly end up leading to a better outcome in a twisted way.
Akira going ahead and fucking her then serves as a cruel reminder of how fucked up both he and this world is, as well as narratively showing him exactly the extent that her trauma affects her first hand. As fucked up as it is, it very well could lead to her growing thicker skin and being more prepared if things end up getting worse in this world as they seem to be.
In red path, he avoids digging deeper and seeing just how much it really affects her with his own eyes and that could end up leading to a barrier between them.

Even knowing this, I still remain steadfast in my decision to shoulder the consequences and hold on to HOPE that we can somehow keep her safe, even if it's just to give her a moment of peace and feeling loved T_T

Surely nothing could go wrong : )

Hey now, Zuko is actually getting pretty good with theirs. They even posted a lighting tutorial recently!
Fire Lord Zuko said:
First off: I really like these renders. I can almost envision it as a 'Battle of Kumon-mi' type situation, where Yumi makes open threats but Nodoka's just messing around.

Secondly: you asked about lighting and shadows, sooo... mini tutorial time.

Here we have before us a KK render involving Kirin and Karin, all posed and basically ready to screenshot:

View attachment 4461871

Looks serviceable, sure. But it could be better. It needs some extra lighting to really make it stand out.

Here's how:

View attachment 4461850

Here's the menu you want to go to (in the top left corner). System > Scene Effects. The above screenshot is all set on Default settings, so this is what you will most likely see. Scroll down until you see Shadow Density.

View attachment 4461855

Note that I have now adjusted my Shadow Density up to 0.85, and changed my Shadow Type to Slight, Smooth Shadows. The shadows should now be far more apparent.

Just because I used these settings, though, doesn't mean you have to follow it to the letter. You can mess around with these settings and see what you like best.

There's the shadows covered, now let's do the actual lighting.

View attachment 4461860

Still in the Scene Effects menu, scroll up until you see Shade and Shade 2. Note the huge dropdown list in the above image. These are all your shaders, and they'll help immensely in making your renders look good. For reference, I'm using the Koikatsu Sunshine Better Repack, so if yours differs in any way, it's probably due to having certain modded shaders installed.

Anyway, I personally like the 'MOD_A' shader, so we'll use it for this example.

View attachment 4461863

You might realize that the render already looks more vibrant than it did before. Shaders are good at that! Again, you can look through them and see what looks best to you.

This on its own could be sufficient enough for you, but I have just a couple more things to mention.

View attachment 4461864

Just above Scene Effects, you'll see a menu labelled 'Char Lighting'. Click that, and the above settings should pop up for you. The Strength setting adjusts the overall brightness, while the two other sliders control the location of the central lighting. Mess around with them until the light is just where you want it to be. (Note: my lighting Strength is set at 1.24 in the above image, but the final renders I show are set to Strength 1.06)

View attachment 4461865

Last thing. You may have noticed Sel uses lens flares a loooot in Chapter 4 in particular. And admittedly, I like the look of them too. They're helpful if you want a specific sort of light in the render itself. Using Lens Flare D as an example, it's usually good at simulating sunlight coming from the sky.

Click the magnifying glass on the left to search up the lens flares. (You can do this with pretty much any item or effect as well)

View attachment 4461866

Move the lens flare into position and there! You have yourself an extra effect.

Admittedly I don't like the look of the above lens flare, as I don't think it fits, but I felt the need to mention them anyway.

With all that information in mind, lets compare the final renders, both with and without added lighting:

View attachment 4461871 View attachment 4461869
View attachment 4461873 View attachment 4461870

Keep practicing, man! It's a really fun and addicting hobby once you get used to it.

Yeah, Kolkatsu — or any 3D modeling app — isn’t for the faint of heart. It takes a while to learn how to get things even into the right positions, not clipping (aka thrusting through each other in ways other than the fun ones), let alone lighting, framing, manipulating hair and clothes so they hang realistically… You need to develop not only a film director’s eye to compose shots on three dimensions (four, if you want to play with animation), but also a fair level of technical skill and a lot of patience.

I’ve played around with KK, Honey Select (by Illusion, the same Japanese studio), as well as more serious engines like Daz and Blender. (I was looking at adapting some of my fiction to VN or graphic novel form.)

And… I’m not sure I’ll ever be any good at it.

Still, it’s fun, if you want to play around with the characters from this game, or others. There are many tutorials to get you started and plugins to add items, functions, etc.

The funny thing is KK started, not as an anime-style 3D modeling engine, but as a silly school harem game of exactly the sort that the early episodes of LiL are spoofing.

Oh—and props to Selebus, for managing to take a fairly basic, limited modeling app and using it to create shots like the ones of Rin blowing bubbles in the baths.

View attachment dndbath30.webp Impressive!

(Yes, I’m pretty sure that most of the shots included in the game are heavily processed in Photoshop or some other pro-level image editing app. Still! Nice!)

And after searching the thread about it.
I think people have some misunderstandings about this event.

I will try to prove the true Identity of 4th God/USER4.

And explain my theory about what was behind the "door"

Now first of all this figure is too important.


We know two things for sure:
1- This figure is real. Because Nao gave a similar drawing to Makoto.
2- This figure is actually represents Akira himself.

Because when Akira asks, "What did you name your baby?
Figure says, he named the baby "-the name we choose for Himawari in the reset -"
so figure=akira

And who is 4th god?

In the picture, we see 'Hope' and 'Wire' on opposite ends, connected to Akira's shoulders, pulling from both sides. just like yasu described how they pull the rope.

in the middle is Pareidolia as a troll mask on akira's face.
he is an asshole troll and possesses akira. just like he is shown in chapter 4.

So this photo contains all the god's/users we know.
But there is a 4th god/user4.
If the other gods are here, shouldn't the 4th one be in the picture too?

4 hearts in the picture symbolise 4 beings too.
So what might be the 4th god in this picture?

Here's the interesting part:
The baby is inside of Akira, not Ayane or another girl.
This implies Akira creates Himawari.

A man giving birth to life = god
Akira is the 4th god/user4

One other little details is, sensei talks to this figure/himself in a shrine, god's house.

if akira is god that explain some other things too.
We know that the 3 gods are actually 1 god at the same time, but there is one more god that they dont wanna talk about it to akira.
why? because 4th god is akira, they don't want him to realize that, they don't wanna lose their precious toy.

And sometimes scenes start with Akira's monologue but end up transitioning to the other users narrating, as if they are the same person.
And the things that Yasu says when she is possessed, like "Everything exists because you want it to exist," make sense when we think of Akira as a god.


Now let me explain what are Nao and Himawari.

Akira says this when he thinks about Nao.


He took parts from other girls (Kaori, Tsuneyo, Chika, Ami, Maya) and created a "lesser god," Nao".
And he created Himawari same way but from Ayane.

That is why Himawari acts like ayane is her mom.
Akira took a part of Ayane to create her.

Weird female god in flora event also says to akira
"you were not meant to be a star"
And later nao draws a pregnant star to explain where she comes from.

if main girls are mother figure for these lesser gods(nao, himawari), then father, Akira himself should be the god/user4.

That is also the reason why Nao gives people weird drawings of a star and multi headed figure.
she is just drawing her dad, just like all other little girls.



After flora, In the event with plants and Nao.
Akira in a blackout state, as user4 destroys plants when they shit talks to Nao.
(Nao didn't destroy plants she was surprised when that happen, but akira was behind her opening his arms menacingly)

And then HimawariCO ambulance comes and restores Nao/template9 from user4/Akira.
(Nao probably shocked after what she witnessed)

This is another HUGE proof because;
The fact that Nao can be restored from user4's save file proves user4 is the source of Nao.
I mean user4 is her dad-Akira-User4.

Now here comes where things get really complicated..

Theory crafting
when we think about what we saw after opening the door at flora event + all the computer language. this makes this story sci-fi not fantasy.

"the subjects" the scientist were talking about are the gods/users.
scientists created the "users" and these "users" created the kumon-mi.
(they said it was them who made this world for Akira)

Experiment was taking one real human mind. turning it to data and creating even more artificial intelligence from it.
this is why scientist points out that users have individuality.
because they are trying to create individual characters from one mind.

that is why nao named template9
because creating new superior AI minds like her is the real purpose of the project.

This also explain why "gods/users are not omnipotent" they are prisoner themself.
"there is no meaning to any of this and that there will be no escape"
Well, where can a character on my SSD run away to?


edit: one more little thing that I realise.
sensei saw an egg when she pat Nao's head.
Because Nao was his egg. he created her. what other reason could it be?
finally all those egg references starting to make sense.


I don't know how much of this has already been discussed here, pls point out the things I missed.
hopefully this will be my final theory so I can stop ruining my poor sleep schedule

posts.content_html_raw:
I might start forgetting things, but when did Haruka learn his name? Is this really just an untold common sense now among many as we march into Ch4?

I liked how this was once treated almost like a forbidden knowledge; it often felt like a special advancement in Sensei's relationship with a certain girl when the name was revealed. But it would appear that either I have been massively misjudging its importance the whole time, or Selly stopped caring about being thorough in this particular aspect and start littering his name like free candies.

Every girl "learning his name" or "being present to a scenario where his name is brought up" on-screen. The earlier these moments were, the more impactful they felt. Nowadays, it's just "yea I just heard your name from someone who already knew when you're not looking. oops". Not even a response from Akira himself when someone somehow knows his name is just sad.

Feel free to point out what I've missed. Also, this entire post will give a certain newbie a death-imminent heart attack.





















These two are debatable. I feel like these two should probably just know because lore, but I am stringent on screen time demonstration. There is one scene in Heartache where Niki mentioned his name when Kaori and Nao were around, but it is uncelar whether Nao and Kaori (especially Kaori) can connect the dots and understand who the owner of that name is.

Fire Lord Zuko said:
Tenchou Tojo. So that's his name... Verrry interesting, and certainly not a reveal I expected at all, let alone at the start of the update.
Click to expand...
Tenchou sounds like 店長, which would be "shop owner". If true, that'd be his title and not his name, especially when Tsuneyo doesn't respond particularly to that name (but well you never know)

Something else that I found interesting upon replay is that when Nao-chan noticed Tenchou-sama's presence in shock, the next thing she did was looking down to what I assume to be her sketchbook. There has been twice now that her drawing match the later appeared abominations, so I imagine this time is a similar deal. At least for the first time, it would appear that Nao-chan drew things only she could see (which Sensei later could too) instead drawing something completely original and proceeding to spawn them. So, to keep the record consistent, my guess is that Nao-chan already saw Tenchou-sama once and has already drawn one Tenchou-sama before entering the shop, but somehow Nao-chan looked reaaaaaally shocked when she saw it though, compared to how calm she was when she pointed out where the first monster was to Sensei..........

And how did Tsuneyo figure out that is her dad?

shmurfer said:
A bunch of these aren't the first time they've learned his name, just the first time they've said it. And I'm not just talking about people who would have already known.

On that note I'd imagine Haruka would have learned it moments after Maki left Akira alone.
Click to expand...
That I understand, and it is not that it won't make sense; it's just something unfavorable and narratively weak for me. Up until a certain point in Ch3, a good portion of the game revolved around Sense being nameless and him rolling with his name being just Sensei because he couldn't do otherwise in the isekai he got reincarnated into. In addition to that, there have been girls who unbelievably did not know his name some time before they either heard it from someone else or started knowing out of nowhere (namely, Futaba and Imani). Because of this, I am stringent when it comes to "who knows, and has the game demonstrated how someone knows". TLDR is that because how this game started, I semi-dislike the idea of his name becoming a common knowledge simply because people talk off-screen.

fdsasdf_p said:
I might start forgetting things, but when did Haruka learn his name? Is this really just an untold common sense now among many as we march into Ch4?

I liked how this was once treated almost like a forbidden knowledge; it often felt like a special advancement in Sensei's relationship with a certain girl when the name was revealed. But it would appear that either I have been massively misjudging its importance the whole time, or Selly stopped caring about being thorough in this particular aspect and start littering his name like free candies.

Every girl "learning his name" or "being present to a scenario where his name is brought up" on-screen. The earlier these moments were, the more impactful they felt. Nowadays, it's just "yea I just heard your name from someone who already knew when you're not looking. oops". Not even a response from Akira himself when someone somehow knows his name is just sad.

Feel free to point out what I've missed. Also, this entire post will give a certain newbie a death-imminent heart attack.

LoveRedHairedGirl said:
Okay. WHAT THE FUCK? NODOKA IS HIS SISTER? I mean, I remember someone mentioned it. But I thought it is mostly tin-foil theory. BUT GOD DAMN.
Click to expand...
https://f95zone.to/threads/lessons-in-love-v0-47-0-selebus.48158/post-13489259
https://f95zone.to/threads/lessons-in-love-v0-47-0-selebus.48158/post-15693019

In general

Tried to take some notes this time.
Have written down "Dorm building is the building in futabas story?".
Ofc i've forgotten why i wrote that. I guess someone in this update mentioned something about a high level floor in a building.
Like: "...the cursed floor 67 in the dorm building..."
Which reminded me that
the building in Futabas horror story also has a high number for the floor things happen.

I thought maybe Miu Matsubara. But its actually Miu Miuhara or something.
Just mentioning because,... note.

I wonder if "Ami Junior" was a jab at Moonflare.
Another sign Sel might be reading here. *Hello

That's it with my notes, because i always think i'll remember the other important stuff no problem.
Damn past me.

Anyway

I wonder if the x.com ayhh "I'm not." post is related to the intro of the Io amusement park event.
You know, the "My Cat" talk and 4.th wall breaking... "Narration"!
Either Sel was roleplaying or he had a depressive episode.

Someone here reposted the last ayhh post.
Something like "Can a wish make a wish?", with the picture.
We have the "prime" girls colors again. Red(x2?), Blue, green and this time also pink(x2?).

I don't think i can pack all my thoughts together on this without further exploding the post, so i'll try to make it quick and dirty.

I already said i think it's possible to boil the cast down to a handful girls, from which the rest might have sprung.
We also had the Nao-Chan/Ami, star related wishes talk.
I also said that i think that at least Ami, Maya and Ayane have their own Agendas, 1-3 of them might just not remember that anymore.

For my theory here, i just can't tell who is supposed to be the singular origin. It's either Sel or Akira.
But my interpretation would be that this could depict how Akira wished for a world like Kumon'mi so he somehow created the prime girls.
And those, through their own will/agendas, created the rest of the cast. "Can a wish make a wish?", or , can a phantasy create a phantasy?.

Cursed Chika TSS.
So, was "Times New Roman"... yeah what actually. The future? A flash forward? Will it be the hub from where we once start the purity routes?
Is it the actual place Akira resides in and conjures Lil?

Are those the fates Akira has to spare the girls from?
Continued in "The Mall".

First off, before i forget.
Was there an image of a plastic uterus in Chikas Tss? Or at least somewhere.
An organ there was in .47, i just can't tell if it really was a uterus.

Because
As i already said, i think maybe the mall is/is a metaphor for an uterus.
(Alexis)
ale "Of course! I don’t think it would keep growing if it didn’t. Plus, there’s that one wing made entirely of organic matter. I think I saw hair growing in there last time."

I wonder,
if Akira is already "The Collector" and he has to collect the girls into the mall.

If we one days come back there and the girls from the TSS's are there, then this theory might gain more spin.
Also i wonder if purifying them one day, would mean to get them "born" into their own self-determined lifes.

A couple posts back someone came up with the idea that the cast are AI. Sorry i didn't note your name down.
That's cool, because it goes in a similar direction as my own "Westworld"ish theory.

Some hints for that have been:
Maya's IT talk.
The omnipresence of IT terms.
The Wire God.
And also very importantly the social science journal.

Here (meaning in this theory), the cast could be hosts/biodroids.
The wishing well/the library could be the main storage for memories, even consciousness. Nao mentions it's the place where all knowledge is stored.
Resets are actually Turing Tests. You make it and can keep going. You fail and get set back.
Important to note here is also how the girls get set into T-Pose during a "Reset". Could be interpreted as a maintenance mode.
Maybe we just never got to see how some scientists arrive to do, ...yeah, the test or maintenance stuff or whatever.
The important thing here is actually the T-Pose itself. Because it's the prime pose for modelling humanoid characters, which would make it (though not necessarily) a metaphor.

As long as it can be tracked down, it can be bought. I wouldn't be surprised if a rich person can find out all sorts of information about me just knowing my name. Even if finding that information costs thousands of dollars each and breaches tons of privacy laws, it can still be bought.

Tsukasa acting all formal in her mothers office feels so strange.

Honestly, the lonely royal seems to be a somewhat common troupe. I'm not surprise at all that Tsukasa is lonely. When everyone says yes and does that for money and stability, they start to become less than human. As the mc mentioned, Tsukasa and Tsubasa doesn't do fun stuff together. She clings to Chinami because she's roughly the same age and is so different from everyone else and doesn't always say yes(I think). She wants the mc as her butler because he is occasionally mean to her which while she might take insult to it, it's also something she desires and something that interests her. Even if some of these things don't apply to this rich girl in particular, it is a common thing in these.

When a woman stands less than a foot away from a man and she looks down and runs a finger on his chest, all I can think about it "there is A LOT of sexual tension here" and I'm not sure if I'm right about that but my mind is telling me I am. This is all assuming that you remove all other context and assume the two people are of age.

Tsubasa doesn't consider her daughters as women until they had sexual and romantic experience is how I'm interpreting that ending as. Any man put in that situation would assume the parents are against that stuff because sex and relationships are taboo or whatever, especially considering their age difference and Touka's starting age. Tsubasa has a different idea however. She could have chosen a better man for the job however, but perhaps she considers the suffering he causes as part of the package.

What? So his problems are a liquid. Touka and Tsubasa are miles above everyone else but aren't pompous. Forget the last sentence. Tsubasa is hydrophobic but Touka is not?

Is there really clothes out there worth more than people houses? That's just stupid. Must follow the same pattern as art, unless it has like miniature diamonds or something all across it, but I think even those are cheaper than the world wants them to be. Don't they say that diamonds are actually more common than gold, yet their value is higher?

You put the fork on the table, use your dominant hand to cut the food and eat with whatever hand you want to eat with. That's it. That's all you need to know to use a fork and also a knife. Being rich DOES sound weird. Wasting invaluable time trying to perfect a useless talent like that...

Wtf? You turn around and see Tsukasa in a swimsuit angry that you won't marry her?

Oh I see. Wonder why Tsubasa didn't tell Touka that the important meeting in question was just family bonding.

Went on a tangent just now. Just being able to see within a manor should have some sort of physical value. So does Touka owe him something for knocking him out with that kick or does the mere presence to a person of her status and her home make up for it?

Thank god Tsubasa told Touka what she expects him and Touka to be up to. Touka's reaction to knowing that her mother basically approve of them sleeping together is quite funny. First, Touka was getting dirty signals from Akira which she brushed off, but then her mother comes and endorses it. I imagine that knowing her upbringing, this means a lot more to her than it might for others because it means her mother has an expectation of her that she's once again not completely comfortable with and puts some pressure on her. There may be that underlying "royalty don't sleep with peasants" thing going on but that essentially shattered right there.
"Who are you and what have you done with my perfect mother!?"
Oh god, Tsubasa used to sleep with her massage staff(or just staff) when she was Touka's age! Touka's wholesome views of her mother comes crumbling down!
Wonder if Touka is gonna be uncomfortable talking to Akira the next time
What an interesting conversation this has been for them.

A school. That part about Yumi wasn't included in the questions but it should have been. Maybe it was too easy to include.

"Cannibal Holocaust"? WHAT THE FUCK? Why?

I think I get why Imani is a bad kisser... Doesn't have enough experience on account of the way her skin is. I imagine she doesn't have any sexual experience at all.

It's a win loss scenario regardless if he chose to stay or leave Nodoka and the other behind. Sticking around would be both selfish and selfless. Leaving would be both masochistic and sadistic.

So Nodoka forcing Otoha and Rin to sixty-nine would be too far for the mc but sexually harassing numerous girls and Yumi is not? The mc wanting to pull the plug on that is fucking cursed as hell compared to what Nodoka has been doing to the others. I don't understand this mc. His reasoning is the complete opposite of mine in multiple instances.

Day 53 character count 7631.
I don't think Haruka is a bad person at all. She's a victim of circumstances. She was given a high libido following her far into adulthood and her sexual partner was taken away from her before proper open marriage or divorce decisions could be made. She shouldn't have to suffer from natures wrath and have a bad person tag slapped on her back for it. Am I wrong for thinking this way? Or is this perfectly reasonable? This is no different from being her husband being forced to go to war in a foreign country. But I feel like if you can somehow survive the horrors of war, you can survive the knowledge that your lonely wife couldn't stay loyal. It's not necessarily her fault or your own and the difference between a war with aliens and a war with a foreign country is aliens and humans. We can blame ourselves for starting a war on our own planet, but blaming the aliens? That depends what we have done to them.
Putting all that aside, I can't think of anything else Haruka has done to deserve to be labeled as a bad person. Her entire story is basically, wanting sex, something something husband, running a cafe, talking to her adult friends. All things considered, she's better than some of the other girls.

And that thing about her fucking him despite there being a bunch of other girls interested in him? I put the blame on him, not her.

Of course all I said to give her the benefit of the doubt seems to be about to change. It's no longer a circumstance thing, it would be conscious acts which break the laws and not just her marriage.
At this point, the mc is already engaging in illicit relationships with some of the students, so it's not like they will be corrupted much further if Haruka is involved and given that there is no pregnancy risk since she's female and no pregnancy risk at all because the timelooping nonsense, you could even argue that the only moral rule Haruka would be breaking is public indecency.

A 2 point handicap seems like a stupid reward for last years. Also I once again cringe at the fact they aren't making an effort AT ALL in telling Makoto that they need to lay low given Ami's dangerous obsessiveness. Arranging a fucking floor wide sleepover at their teacher's house without running it by Ami and Sensei is a death wish(perhaps literally given what I now know).

Welp. Guess Yumi got scammed by a rich child. What a shame.

Same, Noriko. That's the most unusual Yumi expression of all.

Fishing? Really?
Io and Miku competing to see who can build a better raft? These competitions are getting increasingly more unfair, aren't they? Since when have Miku ever built anything? And why do they choose a competition that probably involves loud sounds? Actually, do you even use hammers for rafts? I think the whole point of making a raft is you probably don't have tools and use whatever nature provides.

Molly is jinxing herself so hard right now.
Does Molly or Rin even cook?

Yeah, that seems unfair. Comparing someone who reads who have just started writing to a prodigy who has already published a book or more. They aren't even trying anymore with these competition. Just pit people against each other in random competitions and see what sticks.

Well, it was nice knowing you, Sana and Otoha. A fucking love confession contest! Oh my god! I am SO fucking sorry dude! That stuff isn't easy for anyone, but these two? That's fucking humiliating!
Isn't that kinda insensitive? Making a girl whose already in a relationship and who is JUST discovering love have to do a love confession?

What are they even thinking? Making Ayane and Yasu compete for survival. That can't be legal. Are these two just sitting there coming up with the most outrageous challenges without prior approval from anyone?

Ayane has been out of it since learning what Ami has done in the past...

Wtf is that!? Another weird Maya clone? How does such a cursed thing get into a cathedral?

You know there is something strange about Nao when she somehow shows up at his house at her first event. How does she know where he lives?
"Old enough". Okay! Well I guess Kaori taught her to write so that's good.
And the SECOND thing she writes while in the presence of Ami is "sit on me please" WHAT! Well, it was nice knowing you, Akira.
I had completely forgotten about the babysitting thing... it's only been a day for gods sake!
And the THIRD thing she says is "25% off wieners". Why does everything she says hint at something sexual...?
I say everything before the mc does...
Oh, OOOOH, she's flipping through pages. But wait... why is the first sign "Old enough"?
Okay so all of those scuff live reactions aside, Kaori someone knows where he lives, included a bunch of signs for Nao to hold up that was written by Kaori, some of them oddly specific.
How much exposure to Kaori does Ami even have? Only restauraunts right?

"She is a human" Are you sure?
Ami being jealous at Nao is kinda pushing it.
She noticed the eye colors quite early.
That is way too freakin adorable! Nao headpat!

Is that Kaori asking what a mall is or Nao?
Where did the mugs go...?
Rip Nao's notebook...

How the fuck does Chinami know Nao's name!? Is this some sort of anomaly where Chinami can speak to Nao just like the mc is the only one who understands birds?

Oh god! Chika's reaction to Nao dressing up. Kaori might lose a kidnapped child at this rate.

Everyone will find out about Nao at this rate...

Noriko asks for a box to take her food home with her. Tsuneyo denies it. Previously we learned that the mc never finished Tsuneyo's food he too home and she was offended.

I thought Noriko was that uncomfortable because of the kid... Now I was reminded of what Ami did.

Suspiciously stiff paper...

I knew the moment Nao got the coloring stuff that she was gonna make something cursed.

Mute enthusiastic and energetic children have a habit of being more likable than the ones who can talk. It's weird. Are we all just secretly fed up with listening to the words of others to understand them that when someone who speaks through expression shows up, we are all suddenly invested again?

Uuuuuuuuummmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm...!? That fucking drawing again!

Day 777 is a happy event for me. Crazy.

It's kind of upsetting that Io is the only one who tried to provide essential medicine for Miku. Makoto lives with her. There are numerous girls suffering from their own problems. Maki and perhaps some other adults including Akira could have taken notice. Her whole damn soccer team too and some of them deal with her when she gets to that state too. Why is it that all these people were around and it's Io out of all people who befriends and medicates Miku? I feel like this is that typical story when someone who clearly needs help is ignored by everyone because they are fine almost all the time and everyone is so self absorbed to stop and think.

So fucking true, dude. First of, I agree with Io taking it upon herself to help Miku. Io is experienced with taking medicine and should be able to part that info over to Miku. Second, mental health issues are arguably MORE important than physical, if the physical issues aren't trying to kill you. Just because they are uncomfortable and hard to understand doesn't mean you should turn a blind eye to it. If anything, that's the WORST thing you can do.
Sensei is looking like a huge prick in this situation imo. If the fucking medicine is working, HELP and support them to make sure it stays helpful instead of telling them to stop! I would kill to get something that worked on first try and had minimal to no side effect.

Stopping right at the start of the happy event for today.

Antosha said:
That last quote from Sel, about the characters writing themselves... Props. A lot of writers don't listen to the characters and that's almost always a bad idea. My characters are constantly taking me in unexpected directions, usually better than whatever I'd penciled into my poor excuse for an outline.

Now, mind, with a cast this big, and so full of... highly eccentric folks, I can also imagine the cast's muttering driving Sel nuts.

Or more nuts.

Click to expand...
I think it speaks to the quality of the writing that characters might go against the intentions of plot, since they matter to the writer. It’s part of why they matter to us, too. They aren’t just puppets of the writer; instead, they take on a life and character of their own, so it makes them much more relatable and deep as creations. And considering Sel is intensely conceited, for him to admit that characters take priority over his own ego is a point of relief and positivity, given his usual assholish nature.

Shouldn't dorm 1 escort dorm 2's and vice versa? They could so easily cheat...

I guess the thought of being watched by her dead brother makes Sana hesitant to masturbate but it doesn't get rid of the unnatural horny.

Of course that's where Niki has been this entire time... I wondered how she was gonna fix the issue with the inn being fully booked.
Oh, THIS is the NDA.
And just like that, for a split second, the mc likely rose above Wakana in importance in her eyes. Who would have thought that the strange teacher who thirsts over teens also bangs a famous idol?
That's so fucking dumb dude... You were just chilling, about to head to bed in the bed that the man isn't allowed to sleep in and then suddenly you have to sign a fucking nda so that same man can fuck an idol in the bed. That sounds even more ridiculous now that I write it out!

Time for nicknames.
Yeah I think both Niki an Noriko would reject calling him Selebus.

Damn, Imani and Wakana actually listening to this!
Maybe hearing them go at it will stick with Imani and Wakana hard enough to make them curious and wanting to try...
They are really going at it huh... 2 hours+.
Damn, she is really gonna show them the result of those 3+ hours? If an image was taken of that, Niki would be doomed, my god!
Oh and she's praising his dick in front of them now, huh? They are gonna be intimidated and VERY curious if the memories stick.
They were both considering it, but Wakana was more interested in Niki. Her loyalty to Osako ruined the moment...

Anyone would be worried about Ayane at that point. She was dropped off deep in the forest with no clue what so ever as to which of the 4 directions to go. It might as well be 8 direction. Honestly this is horrible. Leaving an attractive teenage girl in the middle of nowhere at night only wearing a bikini or swimsuit. That's not a test of bravery, that's straight up dangerous.

The game REALLY wants you to think Ami dropped Ayane off way deeper into the forest than she should have. Has Ami already started the "I want to kill all my classmates" yandere ark? Because it feels like that's what this is.

I feel like Ami is pulling a famous evil tactic here. Ayane is acting weird and Ami for whatever reason wants to punish Ayane so she takes Ayane further into the forest than she should, then she tries to get closer to everyone else so they will vouch for her or something if anything bad in the most general sense happens to Ayane.

Well, mystery girl is 1000 times better than some old man wandering the forest, so that's good.

That entire narration and it was Futaba it was talking about...

Looking from behind, I wouldn't be able to tell if it Sensei or Sana judging by the hair, but it was Imani. I think the two of them can bond over their physical traits. Futaba may not like how big she is, but at least her skin isn't... the way it is like Imani.

A teacher should have never approved of putting a half naked teen in the middle of the woods alone. I really don't know what they were thinking approving of that. Even the students should know that is a horrible idea and yet, they went for it.

Saw someone today with skin somewhat similar to Imani's. I could only see her hand and it wasn't any less unpleasant than Imani's. Worse than Imani's even.

These racism bating jokes the darker girls make are really untasteful.

I really hope Imani shows Futaba what she looks like.
Good. They need something to bond over. Uptalk each other's vastly different physical flaws or whatever.

Yasu never took off her blindfold? Really? Well I guess she was guided by God or whatever. Not too surprised. She's just that stupid.

I guess Yasu beat Ayane who had a guide with her. Just how far did they get into the forest?
Touka is right tho. It IS everyone's fault. Just one person INSISTING on changing the rules by threatening to not participate on their own event as well would have sent their half of the dorm to join in on the protests forcing one of the people who organized the mess to veto the challenge and come up with something else. But not a single person tried. There's like 24 people at the beach, 2 of them came up with it so 22 potential people to veto the challenge. How does everyone just unanimously agree to go through with it?

Yasu sees better WITH the blindfold... It has to be that thing she does when she stares into the wall. But we already saw that was her imagination. So is it that? Or the wall?

Maya is more worried about Ayane than Ami is and it's affecting her appetite.

That's the first time I've seen the camera angle slightly shifted on accident.

That's a bad idea, Chika. Don't tell Rin to just break up with Otoha without leaving Rin an alternative.

Both Chika and Otoha are fucked up in that conversation and in general. Chika is way too love struck to even entertain the thought of the mc cheating on her which he is and Otoha doesn't love Rin enough. In a way, Otoha and Akira are the same and Chika and Rin are the same in their relationships.

Makoto "was being a bitch" to Kirin on a past Christmas and not letting her hang out in the bedroom, but I don't remember what that was about. Any ideas?

Wait, really? Yumi wins poetry over 14 others? That's... unexpected.
This is a fucking shitshow. I hope Wakana is proud of herself for choosing Yumi the guard for this and causing a chain reaction.
I swear to fucking god if Wakana takes away Yumi's price for this, she's dropping straight down to F tier, don't fucking try.
Well she's dropping either way because she's a fucking sellout.

Oh god, Noriko, that's a cheap tactic!

Fuck you Wakana, slightly less fuck you Nodoka and even less fuck you Noriko, you are all cheating pieces of shit using dirty tactics!

Double fuck you Wakana! Yumi didn't even win!
Boy, I sure hope she actually gets the money.
Yeah, wasn't Ami's the best back then?

Oh, what a nice surprise! Kaori and Nao joining in! I reacted more positively to that surprise than I think. Maybe it's because of Nao being there? I dunno.
Oh god, here comes Chika!

Something tells me cutting food with a katana is not exactly gonna work there Molly.

It's an actual blobfish... I would not want to touch that thing. Sana is so brave.

Nao sacrificing herself to eat the most disgusting food known to man... What a brave child.

Poor Molly. She became a fish murderer for nothing and couldn't even honor the fish's death by cooking it up properly.

Oh yeah, she did sorta do that. She confessed about the Niki kiss to him.

I feel like neither of them were confessions. Maybe they sort of were? But it seemed more like Otoha's confession was just that she don't dislike him as much as she should and like him but not sexually. Sana's seemed to more or less confirm that she likes him more than Otoha's new point including sexually.

Mischievous Touka with that expression, my goodness...

Yeah, I don't think we get to choose who wins between Touka and Ami. Apparently Ami reminds him of Sekai.
Yeah, he broke out of the memory and instantly declared Ami the winner. Wasn't even a competition...

How badly did Ayane get lost anyway? She should have been out long ago by now. Mystery girl must be up to something.
Speaking of the devil. She just showed up right after saying that.

What a weird horror story.
And Nodoka's story is just as difficult to follow as ever and I wish she would stop.

Oh, it's ALREADY happening. Haruka, Nodoka threesome.

I feel like Haruka's role in the game, tho side character, is slowly taking shape. Sweet on the outside, absolutely depraved in every sense on the inside.

Mc was about to imply he wonders when Rin and Molly gets into this depraved position as well. That moment after he stopped himself, I had some flashbacks to Stormside and I don't want to see this game going down that optional route. Although there are plenty of games covering that very same concept. Headmaster and that new teacher.

This is a little sickening... It's like an actual slave scenario. He can make Haruka let Nodoka take a picture of her. I'm a little uncomfortable knowing that Nodoka can easily use this for blackmail as she have already done that exact thing in the past.
Filming is even worse. This is taking a bad turn, I wish I could choose a more wholesome relationship for Haruka. I can feel this creeping in my stomach.
... Why... They are making video evidence of her saying that she's here to have a threesome with a teen.
She really wasn't kidding when she said she wanted to be more horrible. I can't find the wording. I don't understand why the mc is going along with this, even for Nodoka this is pretty dark. Does it give people like this immeasurable excitement and trust knowing that there is a video like this one upload away from ruining both the adults lives?

"And I'm glad Nodoka is once again using her phone to commemorate the occasion."...

Haruka's "type"... If you had to choose one girl out of all of them that would make Haruka look the absolute worst, who would it be? If we pretended for a moment you didn't already know the answer, it would probably be Sana. She's the most "innocent" of them all and also the daughter of one of her best friends, also one of the younger and smaller girls. Oh what thinks you hide from the world, Haruka... To see your humanity being stripped like this...

It's all about being commanded to... She is too scared of doing it herself, yet the forbidden pleasure is there. She lets someone else control her to strip herself of some of the blame.

And there is it. The point of no return.
The real point of no return was that fateful moment the mc decided to start fucking her, so very long ago.

"paredolia would like to connect" saying no closes the game

Maya took advantage of him and that fucked him up for good? Wonder if there's a deeper meaning to that.

Whatever mystery girl did, it cured Ayane's fear of Ami.

Oh, THAT was the infamous slap that one person complained about! Sure, it was uncalled for, but I find it more funny and deserved than something to spite Ayane for.
Ayane seems genuine, Ami seems manipulative. Ami may act confused and mad about the slap but I think Ayane is just being who she always is but braver.

Kirin lovingly stroking Noriko's chin like that...

I bet Nodoka is gonna include yesterday's encounter in the book despite being told not to.

I can't deny that... Otoha's confession was a little weird. So was Sana's.

Imagine my surprise when I look through Ami's outfits and I see THAT cursed thing! Amy!

I feel like Ayane has decided to take Ami's spot as the most Sensei clingy girl.

Welp. The dev is becoming even crueler when it comes to how long it takes for us to see the spoils of dorm war victory. 8/4 to floor 1. It's possible to tie it however, but that's the best I can do. Gonna have to figure out later if there is a tiebreaker further down the line, otherwise I'm gonna need to figure out what the best way of altering the outcome in floor 2's favor.

And there we go. Dorm wars over. Uta events tomorrow. That could be fun.

I was also going to post the cube audio but that was already done. image=come forward

image=fuckin is the new black

image= we’re like you
cube12=It's time to follow something else instead.
image= We’ve become addicted
cube13=What are you most afraid of.
image=Isn’t it beautiful?
Chika=I’d like to know more about the Summer Blast Savings event at Spacy’s.
cube14=Reach out and touch me.
image=good girl
cube15=I can(OR: can't?) show you the answer.
image=Just like you were taught

I guess there might be some diffeances from what was posted earlier. But I'm pretty confident of everything other than the lines with brackated alternatives.

Which then I guess leads to the stuff after that with Chinami, according to the cube it should be what she is most afraid of.
Which gets me thinking that she might be mentally stuck between 2 things. 1 (what she thinks is her fear): She doesn't want to lose Akira and Have that hurt Chinami and herself. And 2 (her actual fear): She is (subconsciously?) afraid that in changing herself to fit Akira, she and whatever that relationship with Akira might become over time if she fully changed herself to fit him, Could be a terrible influence on Chinami. And there is also probably some concern, now that she knows Akira is fucking everyone, that he could go after Chinami.

But then she seems to go off the deep end and decide to fuck the monster/s(Akira?) with Chinami before it does anything to Chinami without her involvement.

And well, that's a bad sign to me about how insane she might get. If this is Chika subconsciously deciding that to protect her sister she needs to make sure she is involved in the process if/when her presumed predator boyfriend tries to fuck her. She's going to get even more insane isn't she.
Edit: Or maybe that's the fear. That she gets to the point she does that or thinks that's ok.

I could have interpreted thist incorrectly though. I have not replayed it yet to see if it still fits when I go back over it. Might decide I read it wrong, will see.
And i also transcribed the perfect face boy text in the image at the start of "Perfect Hair Forever"



This is perfect face boy
he never stops thinking of the hair
and his little arms
It only appears when a change is
happening
the only way to make him go away
is by dropping beans at his feet
he loves (pork(?)) and parks
he watches the children play
he wishes he was one of them
he is so old now.

The only word i'm not 100% sure about is Pork. But the last letter really looks like a K to me so not sure what else would fit.

Also dropping beans at his feat to make him go away is most definitely not a reference to this following image. But the though of it was funny to me because it seems like it fits somehow.
I'm not ready to make any firm statements about who perfect face boy is. But it does feel like its something to do with Akira. There is also a cat like shape there, (Pet the cat) something related to Maya maybe? and the bsod under it, Wires maybe? (Maya did talk about a religion that sounded like it had something to do with wires at some point right?). No idea how to connect it to the following Nodoka events though. And they only raise more questions.

I did think Nodoka being related to Akira was expected, even sister (half-sister probably?) was possible in my mind. But regardless of the exact relation, how would he have ever had that conversation with her in the past? Their ages don't line up in a way that conversation would be possible, as far as I can tell from the context anyway. I guess it could just be some strange memory thing happening in the present though, or maybe the future...Either way I'm going to be thinking about this one for a while. Could they be stand-ins for other characters? that's going to get too confusing to think about if I go down that path.

Then the next part you get an image in the pareidolia mall style with binary in the top right. The old one sound effect plays over it... And who is in the pareidolia mall, Amy (Ami)...So is that implying an "Old One" connection there, I feel like it might be. That top right binary also translates to "z". And then we are told "Its a straight line it just doesn't look like it" maybe that's something to do with the various pareidolia mall image binary translations. Or maybe its something about time...But then that "z" would imply the image is the end of something.

I don't really want to commit to taking these lines of thinking anywhere yet. too many paths not enough signposts. Or maybe there are allot of signposts, just unintelligible ones.
